permissions.label: Open Workspace
permissions.description: May open the Workspace application at all. Every Workspace API route except GET /api/v1/me requires it.

permissions.label: Edit workspaces and files
permissions.description: Create, rename and delete workspaces; create, save, rename and delete files; apply assistant output to a file.

permissions.label: Browse the catalog
permissions.description: Browse a connection's namespaces, tables and columns, and ground the assistant on a connection.

permissions.label: Preview datasets
permissions.description: Preview the rows of a dataset (Kafka topic preview in the FlinkSQL runner).

permissions.label: Run SQL
permissions.description: Run SQL interactively, and create a SQL job on a Workspace connection.

permissions.label: Run notebooks
permissions.description: Run notebook cells.

permissions.label: Edit dbt projects
permissions.description: Register, change and delete dbt projects in the dbt runner.

permissions.label: Run dbt projects
permissions.description: Start and cancel dbt runs and read their history, events and lineage.

permissions.label: Deploy dbt to production
permissions.description: Promote a dbt project to production.

permissions.label: Edit SQL jobs
permissions.description: Register, change and delete SQL jobs in the dbt runner.

permissions.label: Run SQL jobs
permissions.description: Start and cancel SQL job runs and read their history.

permissions.label: Edit Python jobs
permissions.description: Register, change and delete Python jobs in the dbt runner.

permissions.label: Run Python jobs
permissions.description: Start and cancel Python job runs and read their history.

permissions.label: Edit Flink jobs
permissions.description: Create, change, validate and delete FlinkSQL streaming jobs.

permissions.label: Deploy Flink jobs
permissions.description: Deploy, stop and cancel FlinkSQL streaming jobs.

permissions.label: View data quality
permissions.description: View quality rules, rulesets, bindings, rendered artifacts and quality status.

permissions.label: Create data quality rules
permissions.description: Author new quality rules, rulesets and ruleset items (drafts; nothing runs because of them).

permissions.label: Edit data quality rules
permissions.description: Change or delete existing quality rules, rulesets and ruleset items.

permissions.label: Evaluate data quality
permissions.description: Validate a rule definition and re-render an artifact without changing what runs.

permissions.label: Publish data quality
permissions.description: Change what runs in production: approve a custom SQL rule, bind a ruleset to a job, apply an artifact to a runner, sync checks to the catalog.

permissions.label: Manage privileged data quality
permissions.description: Author privileged custom SQL quality rules.

permissions.label: Commit and push to Git
permissions.description: Commit workspace changes and push them to the Git remote.

permissions.label: Manage connections
permissions.description: Create, change, test and delete database connections, and list UCS catalogs to connect.

permissions.label: Use Workspace settings
permissions.description: Open the Settings page: see which engines Workspace is connected to and which assistant model answers.

permissions.label: View alerts
permissions.description: See alerts, their history, the alert rules and the notification channels (Slack / Microsoft Teams). Channel addresses are never shown.

permissions.label: Acknowledge and resolve alerts
permissions.description: Acknowledge or resolve an alert (also what the Acknowledge / Resolve buttons in a Slack or Teams message do, as that channel).

permissions.label: Manage alert rules and channels
permissions.description: Create, change and delete alert rules and notification channels, send a test message, and run the rules now.

permissions.label: Manage workspace administration
permissions.description: Manage workspace administration: codegen agent and its key, context-egress governance, engine endpoints.
